ED Raids Ex-MLA's Properties, Raises Questions About Corruption and Government Action

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has raided the properties of Deep Narayan Singh Yadav, a former MLA from Uttar Pradesh. The raids were conducted at 11 locations across the state, sparking concerns about corruption and government action. The ED is reportedly investigating financial transactions worth millions of rupees. The incident raises questions about the government's handling of corruption cases and its actions against politicians.
